description: This file defines types and functions related to tools in a loop context, including tool schemas, definitions, and a factory function to create tools for a loop with handling for reporting results and refusing actions.

methods.name: defineTool
methods.description: Defines and returns a tool based on the provided tool definition.

methods.name: toolsForLoop
methods.description: Creates a set of tools for a loop, including handling for reporting results and refusing actions.
